shadows.name: ambient-float
shadows.purpose: Ambient Drop Shadow to lift glass panels.

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The default floating container for all map overlay controls.
components.css: .ds-panel-glass { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 2px solid rgba(82, 82, 82, 0.847); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #313845; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #313845; } .ds-panel-desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #69707a; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; }

components.name: Primary Badge
components.description: Small bold identifier, typically used for logos or key statuses.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #0d2838; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The interface acts as a transparent lens over complex geospatial data. The UI recedes to let the map shine, utilizing glassmorphism heavily to maintain context while keeping controls highly legible. It is a sleek and modern command center that balances a clean analyst workspace with tactical functionality.
keyCharacteristics: High transparency to maximize map visibility.

rules.name: The Map Priority Rule
rules.body: Solid opaque backgrounds are prohibited for floating map controls. If an element sits above the map, it must use the Glass Panel background to preserve geospatial context.

dos: Do use backdrop-filter: blur(12px) for all floating panels.
Do constrain corner radii to 4px or 6px for a sleek, technical feel.
donts: Don't use solid opaque backgrounds for elements placed over the map.
Don't use highly saturated colors outside the defined Deep Ocean/Maritime Blue range.
